title: Time Jump — EOC Activation and Manual Mode

fields.narration: It is now 08:30. The threat has been confirmed: a ransomware actor breached the district via an unpatched HUSD-VPN01 and a shared local admin password. The system is now fully compromised. The EOC is activated. The network has been isolated and staff work from paper. The 05:00 offline roster is the only trusted source for student accountability. The threat to physical safety is active. The next phase is Manual Mode.
worldState: The EOC is now activated at the District Service Center, Room 210.
All district systems are operating in manual mode; digital tools are not trusted.
The 05:00 offline roster is the only verified source for student accountability and reunification.
The Policy Group has been convened. The Superintendent (Dr. Renata Solberg) has been notified and is in emergency session.
The Incident Commander (Marcus Delacroix) has declared a Level 4 incident per EOP 4.3.
The Technical Branch Director (Victor Han) has directed all IT staff to contain the breach and begin forensic analysis using HUSD-CIRP-2026.
The Public Information Officer (Lauren Achebe) has begun issuing ParentSquare alerts and posting on social media to prevent misinformation.
The Threat Assessment Lead (Dr. Hannah Lindqvist) has activated the behavioral threat team to review all flagged student records.
The Law Enforcement Liaison (Sgt. Dana Whitcomb) has confirmed coordination with HPD and Brandt County Sheriff via MS-ISAC and CISA.
All schools are operating under manual procedures. The 05:00 offline roster is in use for attendance, accountability, and emergency contact verification.
The EOC is now fully staffed and operating under ICS structure. All roles are accountable to the Incident Commander.
The decision to close schools for the remainder of the day has been made by the Policy Group and is being communicated to parents via ParentSquare and social media.
fields.facilitatorNote: This is the official shift to Manual Mode. All roles must now follow EOP 6.2 (FERPA compliance during incident) and EOP 4.3 (decision-making authority). The Policy Group must be engaged for any closure, communication, or ransom-related decisions. Watch for premature digital system use or unauthorized contact with the extortion site.
